title: read-only arms, the remainder of #23726: four more sentences say "nothing was written" / "writes nothing" on a SQLite file whose journal mode the connect switches (`os migrate plan` ×2, `summary-nulls` refusal, `secret rewrap` resumable note)
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b): an operator-facing sentence that a measurement at the public door contradicts. It comes from #23726's dev (`os-dev-report` on #23726, `out_of_scope_findings` 1–4, PR #23895 head `7bdbb42af`). #23726 fixed the three sites its own table named; this card carries what that dev's census found beyond them. Seat ruling A on that PR's `open_questions[0]`.

`reach:` measured at the public door for two of the four, on rollback-journal SQLite fixtures. Each run below moved header bytes 18–19 from 1,1 to 2,2 and the change counter by 1, with schema and rows unchanged:
- `os migrate plan` on the CRM fixture plus one `sys_legacy_widget` table printed "They are reported for information only — nothing here drops them, and a plan writes nothing."
- `os secret rewrap --apply --yes`, a finished re-run (0 rows re-wrapped) on a provisioned file, printed "… and a finished run writes nothing."

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## The mechanism (the same as #23622 / #23726)

Each of these runs boots through the SQL driver before it prints, and the driver's connect switches a SQLite file to the journal mode it asks for (WAL by default). That rewrites the file header and no row. So "nothing was written" is false on a SQLite file still on a rollback journal, while "no row or table was written" is true. The established fix (PR #23608, PR #23725, PR #23895): claim "no row or table" (or the command's own noun), and add `JOURNAL_MODE_SWITCH_NOTE` (`packages/cli/src/utils/sqlite-occupancy.ts`) where the target is a SQLite file, tested with `describeDriverSqliteFile(stack.driver?.config)`.

## The four sentences, read on `origin/main` `497518c3f`

| # | Where | Sentence | Printed by | Measured |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts` `:508` | "… nothing here drops them, and a plan writes nothing." | `os migrate plan`, when reserved-prefix tables no object declares are found | yes |
| 2 | `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts` `:1148` and `:1163` | "Refused N write(s) during the declaration boot — a plan writes nothing" and "If those commands only read, nothing was written" | `os migrate plan`, when a plugin write is refused during the declaration boot | read only |
| 3 | `packages/objectql/src/summary-backfill.ts` `:295` | "Refused before any row was read; nothing was written." | `os migrate summary-nulls --recompute-undefined-on-empty` with a name it cannot find, thrown after the boot | read only |
| 4 | `packages/cli/src/utils/sys-secret-rewrap.ts` `:502` (`REWRAP_NOTES.resumable`), mirrored in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` `:632` | "… and a finished run writes nothing." | every `os secret rewrap` run, both modes, text and `--json` `report.notes` | yes |

Rows 1, 2 and 4 are `packages/cli`. Row 3 is `packages/objectql` (`domain:engine`'s file), so a claim on this card declares it on that lane's post, as #23726's claim did.

## Done looks like

- Each sentence claims no row or table (or names what it does vouch for), and the journal-mode note follows it on a SQLite target, by the rule above. One pin per text, a SQLite case and a non-SQLite case where the note is conditional.
- Row 4's docs mirror moves with it.
- No exit code, flag, refusal or `--json` field changes.

## Neighbouring class, noted and not filed (承接者:无)

Write arms, not read-only ones, not measured: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts` `:551` "Aborted — no changes made." (declined after a `deferSchemaDdl` boot), and `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts` `:1542`, `:2483`, `:2494`, `:2503`, `:2540` "Nothing was written." (refusals after the apply boot). They are a different question (a write command's refusal), so they are not part of this card.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included, at this filing:
- `os migrate plan says a plan writes nothing but SQLite journal mode switch changes the file header` → 32 hits. The family is #23562 → #23622 (closed) → #23726 (open, PR #23895), and #21745 (closed, `os migrate duplicates`). None names these four sentences.
- `secret rewrap resumable note finished run writes nothing` → 3 hits: #23726, #21528, #7427. None names `REWRAP_NOTES.resumable`.
- `summary-nulls recompute-undefined-on-empty refused before any row was read nothing was written` → 18 hits. #23726 is the only one in this family, and it names the dry-run line only.

Dedupe words: a plan writes nothing journal mode; unmanaged tables reserved prefix plan writes nothing; rewrap resumable finished run writes nothing; summary-nulls refused before any row was read nothing was written.
